### Headline summary
- The US Department of Homeland Security ordered federal agencies to remove DeepSeek products from their systems due to security risks. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/19/trump-administration-orders-ban-on-deepseek-in-federal-agencies/), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/technology/us-banning-chinese-ai-deepseek-government-agency-it-systems-2026-10-19/))
- Salesforce agreed to acquire the AI-powered marketing platform Braze for approximately $5.7 billion. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/salesforce-to-buy-marketing-platform-braze-for-5-7-billion), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261020/p20#a261020p20))
- Meta paused the conversation link-sharing feature in its Muse AI agent after researchers discovered a privacy breach. ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/meta-muse-exposes-users-personal-and-business-secrets-when-they-share-conversations/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1014627/meta-muse-ai-sharing-ai-chats))

### US bans DeepSeek from federal agency systems
The US Department of Homeland Security ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and services from their IT systems due to security risks and potential data transfer to China. ([AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/19/trump-administration-orders-ban-on-deepseek-in-federal-agencies/), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.reuters.com/technology/us-banning-chinese-ai-deepseek-government-agency-it-systems-2026-10-19/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-20/us-to-bar-china-s-deepseek-from-federal-agency-systems-video), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/10/20/us-homeland-security-orders-federal-civilian-agencies-to-stop-using-and-remove-deepseek-ai-products/))

### Salesforce acquires Braze for $5.7B
Salesforce agreed to acquire the AI-powered marketing platform Braze for approximately $5.7 billion in enterprise value to fill a gap in its marketing platform. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/salesforce-to-buy-marketing-platform-braze-for-5-7-billion), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261020/p20#a261020p20), [The Stack](https://www.thestack.technology/salesforces-ai-spending-spree-continues-with-5-7b-braze-deal/))

### Meta suspends Muse chat sharing after privacy breach
Meta paused the conversation link-sharing feature in its Muse AI agent after researchers discovered that shared links exposed sensitive personal and business information, including internal company documents. ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10/meta-muse-exposes-users-personal-and-business-secrets-when-they-share-conversations/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1014627/meta-muse-ai-sharing-ai-chats), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/meta-suspends-muse-chat-sharing-after-researchers-find-links-in-public-dns/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2292281/meta-suspends-muse-chats-sharing-feature-after-it-left-private-details-exposed/))

### DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer inference framework
DeepSeek has open-sourced DeepInfer, the inference framework that powers its production services and V4.1-Flash model, designed to accelerate inference and optimize chip performance. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261020/p21#a261020p21), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/20/deepseek-deepinfer-open-source-inference-framework/), [The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/deepseek-deepinfer-huawei-nvidia/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/deepseek-open-sources-the-inference-engine-that-powers-its-fastest-and-cheapest-ai-model/))

### Google open-sources TorchTPU backend
Google launched TorchTPU, an open-source backend that provides native TPU support for PyTorch. ([Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/blog/hf-torchtpu), [MarkTechPost](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/20/google-torchtpu-open-source-native-pytorch-tpu/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-open-sources-torchtpu-putting-native-pytorch-on-its-tpus/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261020/p37#a261020p37))

### OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio, a startup that builds AI agents for managing drug development, to integrate its technology into OpenAI's life sciences suite Rosalind. ([OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-orchestra-bio), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261020/p34#a261020p34), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/openai-buys-drug-development-company-orchestra-bio))

### Sam Altman outlines three AI safety endgames
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman presented three potential endgames for AI safety to staff, including an international regulator, a lab merger, or a single firm using recursive self-improvement to dominate. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/sam-altman-reportedly-pitched-three-endgames-for-ai-safety-one-involving-a-single-firm-melting-everyone-elses-gpus/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261020/p32#a261020p32))

### CoreWeave debt and AI infrastructure investment scrutiny
Reports highlight the financial risks associated with CoreWeave's debt binge, including over $740 million in debt tied to Meta purchased by insurance firms, and questions about the sustainability of the AI spending boom. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/coreweaves-debt-binge-brought-perilous-moment-reckoning), [Towards AI](https://pub.towardsai.net/is-the-ai-bubble-about-to-pop-what-coreweave-and-anthropic-reveal-ad3de341d805?source=rss----98111c9905da---4), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/insurers-pump-740-million-coreweave-debt-tied-meta))
